quote.text: It is not that we have a short space of time, but that we waste much of it. Life is long enough, and it has been given in sufficiently generous measure to allow the accomplishment of the very greatest things if the whole of it is well invested.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that every moment spent with your children is an investment—not only in their future but in your own character. By avoiding needless distractions, you cultivate an environment of mindful presence, teaching them to value time and meaningful interactions.
    • Just as Seneca reminds us to avoid squandered time, strive to create routines and habits that enrich family life, ensuring that the time you share nurtures growth, understanding, and lasting memories.
  • Leadership
    • Great leadership is about making conscious decisions to use your time effectively for both personal reflection and strategic action. Focus on prioritizing tasks that contribute to the greater good while fostering trust and inspiration in your team.
    • An investment in well-spent time strengthens not only your vision but also the integrity of your leadership. Embrace the notion that even challenging moments can catalyze innovation and progress when harnessed with intention.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, every decision and iteration counts; by being deliberate with your allotted time and resources, you can steer projects towards remarkable achievements. Avoid procrastination and focus on impactful milestones.
    • Much like Seneca's insight, view time as a generous resource. Allocate it wisely to prioritize learning from feedback, refining strategies, and executing tasks with precision, ensuring that each step adds tangible value to your product’s success.
